//: HRMS database connection for THIS server. Copy this file to dbsettings.json (same folder as HRMS.Web.dll) and fill it in - or run Set-DatabaseConnection.cmd, which asks for the details, tests them and writes dbsettings.json. Publishing never overwrites dbsettings.json. Changes apply without a restart.

ConnectionStrings.//: SQL Server sign-in: Server=SERVER\INSTANCE;Database=HRMS_Kuwait;User Id=...;Password=...;   Windows sign-in (the IIS app pool account): Server=...;Database=HRMS_Kuwait;Integrated Security=True;

Database.//: true when the SQL Server uses its own (self-signed) certificate - the usual case. false only with a certificate from a trusted authority.
